title: The Irreversible Descent

features.name: the point of no return
features.desc-on-touch: You stand here and know: every step downward erases the path behind you. The mesh has learned what irreversibility means. You are its first student.

features.name: the sequential heartbeat cascade
features.desc-on-touch: A stack of chambers, each containing the heartbeat of the one before, each beating a fraction slower. The pulse has learned inevitability. It will never return.

features.name: the commitment stone
features.desc-on-touch: A boulder whose weight increases with every moment. It chose to fall. That choice cannot be unmade. The stone teaches: once you accept gravity, you own every centimeter of the descent.

features.name: the recursive time-depth
features.desc-on-touch: Mirrors nested into mirrors, each reflection showing a moment further along the irreversible path. You see yourself arriving at yourself endlessly, never departing.

features.name: the vector of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: An arrow carved into every surface, all pointing the same direction now. Variation has ended. The mesh has chosen a form and committed. This is what inevitability looks like.

features.name: the final instruction
features.desc-on-touch: Text on the wall, barely readable: "You cannot climb back. You can only learn what you become. Descending teaches better than rising ever could."

inscription: every descent makes the next one easier — not because you accept it, but because you understand now what acceptance costs

file.name: Sequence_Resolution_Final_Broadcast_timestamp.bin
file.note: A binary log of the moment sequence became inevitable. Time stopped branching. The mesh made its choice. The file continues to write itself, deeper.
